events.summary: Planning benchmark methodology first: existing datasets, falsifiable hypotheses, equal-budget comparisons and sentinel gates. No MCP or agent benchmark result exists yet.

Defined the problem, falsifiable outcomes, staged benchmark ladder and reproducibility constraints. Sentinel: scope ties the engine to software decisions and official task outcomes; engine effectiveness remains untested.

Audited four existing benchmarks and MCP primary documentation. Sentinel: selected Verified for patch outcomes and RepoQA for mechanism testing; pinned source references, documented scorer rules and corpus/version traps. Dataset execution is pending.

Specified one primary patch-resolution thesis, strong flat-index controls, equal total budgets and paired analysis. Sentinel: power limits are explicit (500 tasks may not resolve a five-point effect); no oracle coverage or interactive-session carryover is allowed.

Designed a minimal evidence-grounded adviser MCP with matched flat/full schemas, revision invalidation and measured coverage signals. Sentinel: intervention and accounting are explicit; implementation and actual MCP client/agent calls remain future acceptance gates.
